[Act: income-tax-2025
 Chapter: Offences and Prosecution
 Section: 474::Failure to afford facility for inspection of books of account during search.
]


If a person, who is required to afford the authorised officer with the necessary facility to inspect the books of account or other documents, under section
247(1)(ii), fails to do so, he shall be punishable with 21[simple imprisonment for a term up to six months, or with fine, or with both].
